cache.description: Cache name. Null when grouping doesn't include 'cache'.

path.description:
Nested path within the cache entry (e.g., ".fields", ".fields[]", ".methods[].params").
Empty for top-level cache entries.
Populated when {@link Cache.Histo.Spec#levels} > 0 or when 'path' is included in {@link Cache.Histo.Spec#group}.
When grouping by 'path' and levels is unset, depth is unbounded.

javaClass.description:
Java class of cached entries.
Populated when 'javaClass' is included in {@link Cache.Histo.Spec#group}.

app.description:
App-id for cache entry (format: `<cluster>-<env>-<app>`).
Populated when 'app' is included in {@link Cache.Histo.Spec#group}.

pkg.description:
Package name (single word).
Populated when 'pkg' is included in {@link Cache.Histo.Spec#group}.

enabled.description: Cache enabled? When grouped, null if mixed.

appAware.description:
True if this cache is app aware (provides isolation to other apps).
When grouped, null if mixed.

root.description:
True if this cache is a ROOT (authoritative source).
ROOT caches are the primary holders of live objects. Entries not reachable from a ROOT are potential leaks.
Populated when 'root' is included in {@link Cache.Histo.Spec#group}.

entries.description: Number of entries in this cache (or aggregated total when grouped).

memorySelf.description:
Shallow memory in bytes (sum of element.memorySelf).
No double counting - each object counted once.
Populated for element-level groupings (javaClass, path, etc.), and for cache-level output when deep memory is skipped.

memoryDeep.description:
Deep memory in bytes (sum of element.memoryDeep).
Includes children's memory - may have overlap when aggregated.
Populated when deep memory is computed (skipMemoryDeep=false). Used for cache-level output and element-level groupings.

name: Cache.Histo.Entry
